blocks.text: Yeh chapter Python mein Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) ki bunyadi baatein sikhata hai: classes aur objects jo haqeeqi duniya ki cheezon ka code mein model banate hain, encapsulation jo data ki hifazat karti hai, inheritance jo code dobara use aur wasee karne deti hai, aur polymorphism jo programs ko lachakdar banati hai. Yeh sab mil kar achhi tarah munazzam, qabil-e-dekh-bhaal aur barhne ke qabil (scalable) Python applications likhne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.title: Object-Oriented Programming
blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming objects aur classes ki madad se programs design karne ka tareeqa hai. Har object haqeeqi duniya ki kisi cheez ki numaindagi karta hai jis ki apni sifaat (properties) aur rawaiye (behaviours) hote hain, aur classes milti julti khusoosiyat wale bohat se objects banane ke saanche (templates) hain.
OOP data aur rawaiye ko kaamyabi se sambhalne ke liye encapsulation, inheritance aur polymorphism par zor deti hai, jo haqeeqi masail ka programs mein model banane mein madad deta hai.
OOP ke fawaid: modularity, reusability aur asan dekh-bhaal

items: Modularity: code modules (classes) mein bata hota hai, jis se use sambhalna asan hota hai.
Reusability: classes aur objects kai programs ya program ke hisson mein dobara use ho sakte hain, jis se takrar kam hoti hai.
Asan dekh-bhaal: aik hisse ki tabdeeli poore system par asar nahi karti, is liye programs update karna asan hai.
Scalability aur team work: banawat software ko barhne aur dhalne deti hai, aur munazzam, samajh mein aane wala code mil kar kaam mein madad deta hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming programmers ko haqeeqi cheezon, jaise talaba ya gariyon, ke lihaz se sochne deti hai, jis se programs samajhna aur sambhalna asan hota hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Procedural programming aur OOP ka muwazna karta chart banayein, aur woh suratein batayein jahan OOP zyada mufeed hai.

blocks.caption: Procedural programming aur OOP (class activity ke liye)
rows: Alag data par kaam karte functions (qadam)
Objects jo data aur methods ikatthe rakhte
Classes dobara use; inheritance se wasee
Data aam taur par har function ke liye khula
Encapsulation data ko methods ke peeche chhupati
Bare programs jo bohat si haqeeqi cheezon ka model banayein, jaise school ya bank system

blocks.prompt: Object-Oriented Programming kya hai, aur is ke do fawaid kya hain?
blocks.explanation: OOP classes aur objects se programs design karti hai jo haqeeqi cheezon ka model hain. Fawaid mein modularity (code qabil-e-intizam classes mein) aur reusability (code dobara likhne ke bajaye classes dobara use) shamil hain; dekh-bhaal bhi asan hoti hai.

items: OOP: classes (saanche) aur objects (haqeeqi cheezein) se bane programs.
Fawaid: modularity, reusability, asan dekh-bhaal, scalability.
